officialName: Bantam Tools Desktop PCB Milling Machine
description: A small enclosed 3-axis CNC mill that cuts prototype circuit boards straight from EAGLE, Gerber, SVG or G-code files, so you can test a board the same day without sending it out for fabrication. It can also engrave and cut small parts in aluminum, brass, plastics, wood and machining wax. The software finds the tool and bed automatically and can mill both sides of a board using an alignment bracket.

specs.label: Accuracy / repeatability
specs.value: <0.003 in per 6 in of travel / ±0.001 in

specs.label: Minimum trace width and spacing
specs.value: 6 mil (0.006 in); minimum drill size 16 mil

specs.label: Tooling
specs.value: ER-11 collet, 1/8 in shank; smallest recommended end mill 0.010 in (0.25 mm)

specs.label: Power
specs.value: 100–240 V AC, 50/60 Hz, 1.4 A; 50 W typical / 120 W peak

ppeRequired: Hearing protection (advised when near the machine while milling)
Long hair tied back, no loose clothing or jewelry
useRestrictions: Never leave the mill running unattended, keep the safety windows in place, and do not mill steel, glass, or fiberglass/FR-4 unless the FR-4 Milling System oil tub is fitted.
